queries.sql: SELECT `jp`.`id` AS `jenis_id`, `jp`.`nama_pajak`, `r`.`bulan`, SUM(r.realisasi) AS realisasi, COALESCE( ( SELECT SUM(t2.target) FROM target t2 WHERE t2.jenis_id = t.jenis_id AND t2.bulan = r.bulan AND t2.tahun = r.tahun ), 0 ) AS target FROM `realisasi` `r` INNER JOIN `target` `t` ON `t`.`id` = `r`.`target_id` INNER JOIN `jenis_pajak` `jp` ON `jp`.`id` = `t`.`jenis_id` LEFT JOIN `desa` `d` ON `d`.`kode_desa` = `r`.`kode_desa` WHERE `r`.`tahun` = 2026 GROUP BY `jp`.`id`, `jp`.`nama_pajak`, `t`.`jenis_id`, `r`.`bulan`, `r`.`tahun` ORDER BY `jp`.`nama_pajak` ASC, `r`.`bulan` ASC
